On Fri, Feb 20, 2026 at 09:03 AM, dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com> wrote:
> Folks — forwarding Acme's question. Short summary: they prefer to avoid a PO for a small pilot (~$2k). Can Finance / Legal confirm if we can accept an invoice (Net 30) without a PO and what approvals we need?

Thanks for the ping. Short answer: we prefer POs for all vendor relationships to ensure proper GL coding and audit trails, but we allow exceptions for low-risk, low-dollar pilots under $5,000 with Finance approval + a completed PO-exception request.

Practical steps:
- For pilots below $5,000: vendor can be set up and invoiced on Net 30 if Revenue Ops (that's me) signs off on the PO-exception request and we have a minimal vendor profile on file.
- For $5,000 and above: PO is required before we accept invoices.
- Required docs for exception: completed vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (vendor legal name, tax id, bank remittance), PO-exception-request-template.docx (reason + approver chain), and a basic risk checklist.

Lead times:
- Exception review: 1-3 business days once docs are submitted and owner approves.
- Full vendor setup with PO: 5-7 business days.

I'm attaching the onboarding form and the standard exception template. Fill those out and I can route for approval. If you want, I can pre-approve for this specific pilot contingent on the onboarding form fields.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, po-exception-request-template.docx

Neha Kapoor
Manager, Revenue Operations (Finance)
Redwood Inference

From: rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 14:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Onboarding + PO process question — Acme Tools

Dylan / Neha —

Legal is comfortable with an exception for a one-time pilot under $5k provided we get the following before any work begins:
- Signed minimal MSA or at minimum the standard purchase terms acceptance (we can use a short form MSA),
- Signed SOW or email confirmation of scope and price (to avoid disputes),
- Completed vendor onboarding form with remittance details.

If Acme is unwilling to sign any terms, we cannot proceed on invoice-only. We should also note that an exception does not change our right to request a PO later for sustained or repeat purchases.

I'll draft a short acceptance clause we can send along with the onboarding form if you want — it clarifies liability and IP are covered under our standard terms.

Rachel Kim
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Acme_MSA_draft.pdf (PDF, 210KB)]

From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>

Maya — thanks for the quick follow-up today. Per our internal review, we can proceed with your pilot on invoice (Net 30) without a formal PO as a one-time exception under $5,000 provided we get the signed onboarding docs below before any work begins:

- Completed vendor_onboarding_form.pdf
- Signed short-form MSA or explicit email acceptance of our standard purchase terms (see attached draft from Legal)
- A one-page SOW listing scope, deliverables, and the pilot price

If you can return those items by Friday EOD, Finance (Neha) will expedite the exception approval and we can kick off next week. Once you return the forms I'll kick off the internal approval (Neha: please confirm you'll route for expedited review once received).

Next steps for us:
- Maya: send completed onboarding form + signed MSA/SOW (I can accept DocuSign or PDF)
- Neha: prep exception approval and confirm once vendor is set up
- Rachel: confirm attached MSA is sufficient for Legal sign-off

Appreciate the flexibility — excited to get Acme started.

Best,
Dylan
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
